text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: There, that's all of today's drills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's training is going well,
and
she's getting into the swing
of it. But
something is still missing...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Really nice results today! You're almost
ready for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Hehehe, guess I better get
ready for my big reward, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there it is! Sure thing,
lemme just make
a reservation for that
premium dessert
buffet you've been dreaming about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing other trainers with their racers, I
can't help but think...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the most part, I only see her during
training. I know next to
nothing about
Taishin herself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What? I did all my routines. Am I missing
something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really. I don't have time to keep you
company anyway. I'm gonna
cool down
and head back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she's gone... Hopefully I'll get to
know her better as we train
more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day,
a letter goes out to all faculty. It
turns out to be a bonus
from the
academy—tickets to an aquarium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I would've invited Taishin, but she turned
me down last time I tried.
So, I head off by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a small aquarium in the suburbs,
quiet
and with only a sprinkling of
visitors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...One of whom I recognize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I debate whether to say something,
she mumbles to herself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something's different than usual.
Perplexed, I watch silently as she
drifts off
to another area.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's a small aquarium, and as I stroll
around, I wind up seeing her
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's standing by the "Fishy-Fun-Time"
touch tank, staring down the
doctorfish
inside.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Here I go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She cautiously checks if anyone is around,
then gathers her courage
and dips a hand
in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her worry melts away as the squirming fish
tickles her fingers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, as the sun begins to set...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are barely any visitors now. The
aquarium is still and noiseless
as the deep
sea.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And all alone,
joyfully snapping pics of the
energetic sea creatures, is
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For someone who hates groups, she has an
awfully big smile looking
at the school of
fish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha! It's you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I freeze like a deer in headlights. A wave
of embarrassment washes
over me as I
struggle to reply.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smooth. If she realizes I was watching her, I don't even want to think how mad she'll be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's always like this here, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She smiles,
not a hint of anger to be heard
in her voice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's the tranquil blue ambience...
but she seems so gentle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's another bigger, fancier aquarium
nearby. So pretty much
everyone goes
there now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's always quiet here. Most
come by themselves. And they're all
fish-lovers,
so they just stare at the tanks
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They don't give a second thought to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pauses, her words fading into the
background music.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For all the time we've spent together,
I've
never seen her make a face
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But how about you, fishies? I wonder if
they notice me... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, it doesn't matter. They aren't
really watching. They're just
around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine...
I like it that way—makes it easier
for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, what's that grin for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That so? You're kinda weird sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta go. This place closes pretty
early, so watch out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look on as the mysterious aquarium-goer
disappears into the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hopefully, it's a sign of progress.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoo-hoo! A new record! Hey, maybe it's
time to make reservations
for the premium
dessert buffet, huh?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a minute! Breaking your record's
amazing, but the dessert's
your big prize
for when you win the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The banter between trainer and trainee
looks fun, but this time... I
feel a little less
envious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yep... Enough chitchat though. Let's keep
it moving.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, is it me, or are you crazy happy
today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to realize that I'm happy the
way
things are.
